id: # The year of the Armenian Apostolic Church: the five Tabernacle feasts
# (Theophany, Easter, Transfiguration, Assumption and the Exaltation of the
# Cross), each with its Sundays after, and the many feasts kept on a set weekday
# The year begins with Advent (Hisnak) on its First Sunday, the Sunday nearest
# 25 November; its fifty days of fasting begin the Monday after the Sunday
# nearest 18 November and end with the Nativity and Theophany on 6 January.
